summary: A small status label, in three tones, six colors, four shapes and three sizes, with an optional dot, icon, count or close button.

props.name: tone
props.description: `outline` is a neutral bordered badge regardless of `color`. `subtle` and `solid` tint every part of the badge, including the dot, count and close button, to `color`.

props.name: color
props.description: Every colour family in the palette. Only visible on the `subtle` and `solid` tones; `outline` stays neutral. It sets the badge, its dot, count and close button together, which is why `className` alone cannot replace it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding, text size and icon size together.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the badge. `inset` reads as a well, `outset` as a raised chip.

props.name: icon
props.description: Any icon. The slot is sized to the badge and the color is inherited, but a glyph that carries its own width and height keeps them - pass it at the badge's icon size (`w-3 h-3` on `sm` and `md`, `w-4 h-4` on `lg`).

props.name: dot
props.description: A small leading status indicator, tinted to `color`. Typically used alone, without `icon`.

props.name: count
props.description: A trailing numeric badge. Reads as attention-red on `outline` regardless of `color`, since a notification count usually means the same thing no matter the parent badge's own theme.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Renders a trailing close button & calls this when it's pressed. The badge itself does not track dismissed state - remove it from whatever list renders it.
